papers.title: Cross-Centaur: Modeling Individual Decision-Making Across Psychological Tasks with Language Models
papers.reason: It develops an individual-level computational model predicting human trial-by-trial decision-making across psychological tasks, directly matching computational modelling of cognition and decision making.

papers.title: Reversal of refractory epilepsy in an adult with GAMT deficiency: A case report and comparative literature review
papers.reason: It is a clinical epilepsy and metabolic disorder case report with EEG findings but no substantive focus on executive function, cognitive modelling, or cognitive assessment biomarkers.

papers.title: Dynamic adaptation of attentional control across bilingual interactional contexts
papers.reason: This human EEG study directly examines attentional control using antisaccade behaviour, theta/delta power, and frontoparietal connectivity, providing findings that could inform models of executive attention.

papers.title: Hierarchical affective predictive imbalance in adolescent borderline personality disorder: task-evoked fMRI evidence from multimodal machine learning
papers.reason: This clinical task-fMRI machine-learning study classifies adolescent BPD and includes inhibitory control and predictive-processing framing, but it does not directly model executive function mechanisms.

papers.title: Functional brain activity in cancer-related cognitive impairment: a scoping review of EEG studies
papers.reason: This review covers EEG markers of clinical cognitive impairment including attention-task ERPs such as P300, but its focus is broad and not specifically executive-function modelling.
